Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) recruitment is 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to attend the walk-in interview on the specified date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,200/- per month, which includes Rs. 56,000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree (including integrated PG degrees). For Engineering, IT, or CS fields, a Four-Year Graduate Degree is required.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) post in AIIMS Gorakhpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the date of the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) recruitment will be held on 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the AIIMS Gorakhpur located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Gorakhpur is located in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh.
